subtitle: Shared documents
note: This page lists documents shared with FTCI for the new hotels website project. Documents are added here only after approval.

documents.title: Enabling Online Payments (Razorpay)
documents.description: What FTCI needs to do to enable direct online payments via Razorpay — the KYC documents to gather, the step-by-step process, the costs, and how to start collecting payments right away.

documents.title: Guest Website — Interactive Preview
documents.description: Click-through preview of the new FTCI Hotels guest website — home page, all four hotel pages with your real room rates and photographs, Board of Directors, gallery, and the direct booking flow, on desktop and mobile. Updated 5 August: every price is now shown inclusive of tax, as confirmed; the ₹500 late-cancellation charge applies to all four properties; and the new Gangtok photographs are in place.

documents.title: Staff Console — Manager App (mobile)
documents.description: Click-through preview of the FTCI Manager mobile app for hotel staff — the full designed set: front desk (Today, Bookings, Calendar, Inbox, Check-in/out, Walk-in, Housekeeping), bookings & recovery, rates & demand, guest relationship, and compliance & finance (Form C, payments, roles, reports). 112 screens across 22 flows. Best viewed on a phone.

documents.title: Home page — how the Potala is shown
documents.description: Why the dark shading over the Potala was removed, what was tested and rejected, and the two ways of showing the photograph — side by side.
